sources.title: Demande de Visa en ligne : La plateforme eVisaburkina lancée
sources.officialityEvidence: A live Ministry of Security page records the official eVisaburkina launch and identifies the Ministry's visa-security project. It authenticates the service but is not a current nationality schedule or controlling instrument.
sources.supportingExcerpt: tout étranger, assujetti au visa, qui souhaiterait se rendre au Burkina Faso, pourra formuler sa demande en ligne

sources.title: Service Public Burkina Faso: e-visa MSECU directory entry
sources.publisher: Service Public, Government of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government Service Public directory has a separate e-visa card assigned to MSECU. Its literal href is 'visaburkina.bf', without a scheme, so it is a malformed relative link and does not independently authenticate the canonical Visa Burkina URL; the live Embassy link does.

sources.title: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye: visa service
sources.publisher: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy page is on Burkina Faso's diplomatic-government domain. It directs short-stay applicants to Visa Burkina and describes an EVISA sent after acceptance, but names no passport nationality or exemption cohort.
sources.supportingExcerpt: En cas d’acceptation de sa demande, le demandeur recevra un message email contenant en pièce-jointe, un document « EVISA»

sources.title: Visa Burkina: short-stay visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The exact service is authenticated by the live Ministry of Security launch page and a live Burkina Faso Embassy page that links applicants to it. This page states the generic short-stay purpose and duration, not a passport-nationality eligibility rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Il est accordé à tout étranger qui vient au Burkina Faso pour des raisons de tourisme, d’affaires ou de visite de famille.

sources.title: Visa Burkina: entry conditions
sources.officialityEvidence: The live entry-conditions page belongs to the Ministry-authenticated Visa Burkina service. It preserves an exemption qualification but supplies no current list identifying exempt nationalities or passport types.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un visa d’entrée ou un accord de visa ou un permis ou titre de séjour sauf exemption

unresolved.reason: Not established. Current official workflow evidence identifies an MSECU e-visa service and, through a live Burkina Faso Embassy page, Visa Burkina short-stay processing with an EVISA emailed after acceptance. The service directory's displayed 'visaburkina.bf' href is malformed and is not used as a standalone portal link. Neither the current workflow material nor the entry-conditions page publishes a controlling ordinary-passport nationality eligibility, exemption, prohibition or suspension schedule for this passport. Generic portal wording and the rule 'sauf exemption' do not establish a status.
